messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: Autopager -> High 5xx rate on inference-gateway-usw2 (5xx_rate > 2% for 3m). PD: https://pd.example/INC12345 

pagerduty: Escalation: paging prod_oncall (primary) and sre_rotation (secondary). See metrics snapshot: https://dash.example/5xx?range=5m

prod_oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Any immediate customer reports?

 diana: Looking at SLOs now — spike started ~14:34, peaked ~14:38. Frontend error rate ~8% for /v1/generate on us-west-2.

 sre_alex: Checking ingress logs, seeing a bunch of 502s from kvcache timeouts and grpc EOF. No code deploys in last 45m.

 travis: Also seeing retry amplification in the edge: retry_count metric up 3x. Could be short-lived kvcache slowness causing fanout.

 prod_oncall: @diana run a quick grep for the 502 signature in gateway pods and paste sample log lines. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/kvcache-502

 diana: Running: ```kubectl -n prod logs deploy/gateway-usw2 | grep "502" | tail -n 50```
Sample: `2026-03-17T14:37:12Z gateway us-west-2 kvcache: request failed: context deadline exceeded`

 sre_alex: That matches kvcache timeouts. I'm going to drain one inference pod to force traffic redistribution and see if error rate drops. Annotating action.

 prod_oncall: Go ahead. Please annotate with node/pod ids.

 sre_alex: Draining pod: gateway-usw2-42abc. Command: `kubectl drain gateway-usw2-42abc --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> in progress.

 travis: If retries are the culprit, reducing retry budget on the edge for the short term might help. Suggest toggling route fallback to medium.

 prod_oncall: @travis do that after we see result from drain.

 sre_alex: Drain finished. Pod removed from rotation. Within 60s 5xx rate fell to 3.1%.

 diana: Customer impact check: search returned ~12 support tickets in last 30m mentioning failed responses / timeouts, mostly low priority. No pagered customers flagged.

 prod_oncall: Good. Keep watching for 5 more minutes. If rate < 1.5% for 5m, we'll resolve PD and file follow-up.

 pagerbot: Alert state: acknowledged by prod_oncall. Auto-escalation suppressed.

 travis: I've temporarily reduced edge retry_budget for the inference route: `edgectl set retries inference_route --budget 0.5` — monitoring.

 diana: After retry budget change, retries down, 5xx steady ~1.2% for 2m and falling.

 prod_oncall: Creating follow-up ticket IN-4573 for kvcache latency regression, attaching logs/dashboards. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

 sre_alex: Flagging for postmortem. Hypothesis: kvcache client saturation from a hot prefix + retries. Will capture heap/latency histograms.

 prod_oncall: Handoff note: night-oncall will take over at 15:00 PT. I'll add runbook steps to ticket. If anything regresses before then, re-open PD. Otherwise I'll resolve after stable window. :thumbsup:

 travis: Noting mitigation steps: drained pod (temporary), lowered retry budget (temporary). Recommend scheduling a kv cache config review tomorrow.

 diana: Adding support ticket IDs and sample logs to IN-4573.

 prod_oncall: Closing conversation in 10m if stable. Thanks all.

 pagerbot: Notification: Incident resolved (auto-close pending) — PD incident will be closed if no new alerts in 10m.
